시편 112:1.content: Praise ye the Lord. Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

시편 112:2.content: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

시편 112:3.content: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

시편 112:4.content: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

시편 112:5.content: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

시편 112:6.content: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

시편 112:7.content: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.

시편 112:8.content: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

시편 112:9.content: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

시편 112:10.content: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
